methods_quotes.q: Ct values were obtained for 211 specimens tested using a noncommercial real-time RT-PCR panel
COVID-19 cases were matched with the state immunization registry.
A cluster-associated case was defined as receipt of a positive SARS-CoV-2 test
there was no significant difference between the Ct values of samples collected from breakthrough cases and the other cases
Whiskers represent minimum and maximum observations
